headline: Wall Street's holiday half-day opens higher and the metals rebound broadens, while European gas slides and oil stalls before Sunday's OPEC+ meeting

findings.headline: Silver leads a broad metals rebound into the US open
findings.body: Precious metals extended their recovery from this week's 15-month lows, with silver, platinum and palladium outrunning gold, and copper and the big miners joining in. Kitco ties the move to a softer dollar, renewed Chinese physical buying and easing forced selling after the tech rout; Barron's quotes Trade Nation calling Wednesday's tech-led rally the only real catalyst. A December Fed hike is still almost fully priced, so the bounce has a ceiling unless the dollar keeps slipping.

sources.label: Kitco: Gold rallies above $3,600, silver surges as dollar weakness supports metals
Barron's: Gold and silver prices rally. Is the bottom in?

findings.headline: Oil keeps its Gulf premium but stalls ahead of OPEC+
findings.body: Brent touched its highest since 9 November this morning after the Jazan refinery strike and tanker attacks near Hormuz, then gave back part of the gain into the afternoon. Reuters reports OPEC+ has an agreement in principle to keep first-quarter 2027 targets unchanged at Sunday's meeting, with the capacity review the open fight. ANZ sees room above $100 a barrel, but only with evidence that deliverable supply is actually constrained.

sources.label: Reuters (via Euronext): Oil on track to snap three-week losing streak over supply fears
CNBC: Brent trades near month's high as Mideast conflict threatens supply

findings.headline: European gas falls on milder forecasts and Norwegian flows
findings.body: Dutch TTF slid through the morning, briefly down more than 7% intraday, on milder weather models, more wind and the expected return of Norwegian flows after maintenance and outages. It diverges from crude even though EU storage is only about two-thirds full, far below the five-year norm, and Gulf LNG cargoes still face the Hormuz risk.

sources.label: Il Sole 24 Ore Radiocor: Europe gas prices slip below 82 EUR/MWh on Norway gas flow hopes
Anadolu Agency: European gas prices fall on milder weather, higher Norwegian supply expectations

view: Our view: This is still a relief rally in thin holiday trade, not a turn. A near-certain December Fed hike and a firm dollar cap the metals, oil now hinges on Sunday's OPEC+ meeting and on whether Gulf attacks actually cut deliverable supply, and gas looks too quick to price relief with storage this low.
